audio.text: If I were you, I'd talk to the advisor before dropping that class.

options: You're right, I don't want to lose my financial aid.
I dropped my phone in class today.

why.en: Agreeing with advice and giving a reason. C uses "dropped" with a different meaning.
why.tr: Tavsiyeye gerekçeli katılım. C "dropped" kelimesini başka anlamda kullanıyor.
